info.name: Mist Admins Orgs Clients - Wired API

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `device_mac`, `mac`, `port_id`, `site_id`, `type`, `vlan`

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

items.docs:
Count by Distinct Attributes of Clients

Note: For list of available `type` values, please refer to [List Client Events Definitions](/#operations/listClientEventsDefinitions)

params.name: auth_state
params.description: Filter results by auth state

params.name: auth_method
params.description: Filter results by authentication method. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by client learning source. enum: `lldp`, `mac`. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: site_id
params.description: Filter results by site identifier

params.name: device_mac
params.description: Filter results by one or more gateway or switch MAC addresses where the client has connected. Supports comma-separated values

params.name: mac
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*bccddeeff`) are not supported. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: port_id
params.description: Filter results by one or more port identifiers where the client has connected. Supports comma-separated values

params.name: vlan
params.description: Filter results by one or more VLAN IDs. Supports comma-separated values

params.name: ip
params.description: Filter results by one or more IPv4 addresses. Supports comma-separated values

params.name: manufacture
params.description: Filter results by manufacturer. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: text
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC address, hostname or username. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*ddeeff`) are not supported

params.name: nacrule_id
params.description: Filter results by NAC rule identifier

params.name: dhcp_hostname
params.description: Filter results by DHCP hostname. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: dhcp_fqdn
params.description: Filter results by DHCP FQDN

params.name: dhcp_client_identifier
params.description: Filter results by DHCP client identifier. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: dhcp_vendor_class_identifier
params.description: DHCP Vendor Class Identifier. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: dhcp_request_params
params.description: Filter results by DHCP request parameters. Accepts multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.
